cost_model_correction.headline: the committed plan's unit cost was wrong, and measuring it first is what kept the run inside the cap
cost_model_correction.plan_said: 0.54 credits per attempt; a refusal costs the same as a good page
cost_model_correction.measured: 1 credit on success, 0 credits when the origin refuses every engine
cost_model_correction.how: one probe per distinct host before committing spend; the two refused probes moved the balance by 0
cost_model_correction.why_it_mattered: 22 of the 36 rows were refused, so the run cost 17 rather than the predicted 19.44. Had the wall fallen the other way, 36 successes would have cost 36 credits and the cap would have truncated the run at 18 rows -- which is why the cap was enforced on attempts with a live balance re-read every fifth call rather than on the plan's arithmetic.
cost_model_correction.reconciliation: vendor-reported per-call credits summed to exactly the live balance delta, 17 == 17

double_buy_guard.measurement_overhead_acknowledged: 4 credits were spent on host probes whose documents were not persisted, and those four rows were then fetched again in the run. That is 4 credits of avoidable duplication inside this order -- the probes should have written their artifacts. It is counted in the 17 and is not hidden.

parallel_safety.why_no_registration_is_needed: run artifacts were written to the session scratchpad rather than to data/acquisition/, so this order creates no run directory. The test that polices OTHER_MARKET_RUNS enumerates DIRECTORIES under data/acquisition/, and the adapter's own call ledger is a single file under a path the repository gitignores in full.
parallel_safety.additive_merge_note: no OTHER_MARKET_RUNS entry was added, so this order cannot conflict with the concurrent Pittsburgh run on that container. Should a later Indianapolis order need one, it must add Indianapolis entries only, and an integrator resolving a clash with Pittsburgh must preserve BOTH sets rather than choosing between them.

regression.why: two of this order's four artifacts (the Firecrawl evidence and the rebuilt pending inventory) match no PATH_RULES entry and classify UNCLASSIFIED. regression_delta.py states that the rest of launch_packages/pettripfinder deliberately stays unclassified and is not to be tidied away with a blanket rule, so the matrix was obeyed rather than worked around. The order itself instructs this: obey the classifier when it conservatively requires a full run.
regression.one_run_answered_five_questions: the full suite is a superset of the four required lanes, so it was run once and each lane's result was read out of it by node id rather than paying for four additional runs

collection_delta.why_benign: the baseline was taken in a fresh worktree without the data corpora present here; all 87 extra cases passed and the failing set is identical node id for node id
